# spoke_ci_governor (Resource)

Experimental operator CI supply policy through the separately pinned provisional ci-governor-v1 HTTPS contract. Requires existing organization, project and environment scopes. Synthetic installed tests do not qualify a native service, workers, warming, handoff or billing. Customers use workflow demand without capacity Terraform.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Experimental operator declaration. Requires an existing operator scope and
# authorized references. The provisional profile does not launch workers.
resource "spoke_ci_governor" "internal_ci" {
  management_key        = "operator-ci-v1"
  name                  = "internal-ci"
  admission_policy_id   = "internal-entitlements"
  budget_policy_id      = "pilot-budget"
  cache_policy_id       = "tenant-cache"
  execution_profile_ids = ["linux-x86_64-v1"]
  max_active_jobs       = 2
  max_allocated_vcpus   = 16
  max_warm_runners      = 0
  max_job_seconds       = 3600
  max_queue_seconds     = 60
  retirement_policy     = "drain"
  deletion_protection   = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `admission_policy_id` (String) Existing authorized admission entitlement. Immutable while this governor owns it.
- `budget_policy_id` (String) Existing authorized budget policy reference; no spending is qualified.
- `cache_policy_id` (String) Existing authorized managed-cache policy reference; no cache is provisioned.
- `deletion_protection` (Boolean) Apply false before retirement. Caches, artifacts and retained usage keep their separate owners.
- `execution_profile_ids` (List of String) Exactly ["linux-x86_64-v1"] in the provisional profile; this is not execution qualification.
- `management_key` (String) Stable non-secret identity supplied in configuration before dispatch. Retire before changing it; recreation requires a new key.
- `max_active_jobs` (Number) Explicit policy bound from ci-governor-v1. Zero-demand changes launch no workers.
- `max_allocated_vcpus` (Number) Explicit policy bound from ci-governor-v1. Zero-demand changes launch no workers.
- `max_job_seconds` (Number) Explicit policy bound from ci-governor-v1. Zero-demand changes launch no workers.
- `max_queue_seconds` (Number) Explicit policy bound from ci-governor-v1. Zero-demand changes launch no workers.
- `max_warm_runners` (Number) Explicit policy bound from ci-governor-v1. Zero-demand changes launch no workers.
- `name` (String) Policy name.
- `retirement_policy` (String) Must be drain. Uncertain leases, capacity and unsettled usage prevent completion.

### Read-Only

- `active_jobs` (Number) Observed active jobs, never a desired count.
- `active_revision` (Number) Controller-selected active revision.
- `allocated_vcpus` (Number) Observed allocated vCPUs, never a desired count.
- `blockers` (List of String) Bounded runtime or drain blockers; reads do not resolve them.
- `id` (String) Canonical import ID: organization/project/environment/governor_id.
- `operation_fingerprint` (String) Canonical scope, owner and request commitment frozen by the plan. This is not a credential or a durable acceptance receipt.
- `operation_id` (String) Original retained management operation ID.
- `operation_sequence` (Number) Selected plan sequence or latest observed request sequence. Timeouts never allocate a successor.
- `operation_status` (String) Latest retained request status; accepted does not mean applied.
- `owner_id` (String) Principal owning the retained management key.
- `readiness` (String) Controller observation; an applied declaration can remain disabled with execution_unqualified.
- `resource_id` (String) Opaque governor ID.
- `revision` (Number) Desired policy revision used to fence mutations.
- `unsettled_usage` (Number) Observed unsettled usage.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import observes the existing owner; it does not transfer ownership or resume work.
terraform import spoke_ci_governor.internal_ci example/operators/internal/governor-00000002
```
